**Batch Cloning Installer v3.0**

The new version has **Download** button, which allows to save clones locally on your PC without installing them.

Download is required only once. So you can download the clones immediately and install them later.

We also have added support for Linux and updated the blog post with a detailed manual for every platform:

[Batch Installation from Windows](https://nomixcloner.com/tpost/1ysvzuctb1-batch-cloning-and-installation-for-andro#windows)
[Batch Installation from Linux](https://nomixcloner.com/tpost/1ysvzuctb1-batch-cloning-and-installation-for-andro#linux)
[Batch Installation from macOS](https://nomixcloner.com/tpost/1ysvzuctb1-batch-cloning-and-installation-for-andro#macos)

content:
You've asked for it so long and finally we're here! 🤜

**CHOOSING HARDWARE SPECS**
You can now manually choose which phone model you want to be presented by your clones.

**MOST MODERN SPECS ADDED**
8 new specs were added, making it total of 20 specs to choose from. See the video!

**NEW APP**
Added VINTED app as requested.

**SSL DISABLING**
New feature in Profile Options in <@&1238778698329751582>_bot that opens crazy possibilities. Nomix developer will be talking about it on today's Live Stream. Start in 1.5 hours, prepare your Zoom, link is already in Telegram channel.

Hi @everyone! This channel is about important news from NomixCloner kitchen. The goal is to keep <#1238789938703634565> for discussions and have this channel for announcements to let everyone be updated on our ongoing work.

Let me cut this to the hot 🔥 topic. **Very long cooking time .**
In detail:
1. Cooking time is enormously big (especially for batch cloning) right now
2. Responses from the bot are slow.

We are working on fixing this. Why it's not easy:
1. **Traffic significantly increased after our latest update, and we were not ready (our bad)**. For those who missed, the update was mostly related to device UUID spoofing in Instagram.
2. **Right now we generate 1.5k clones per day and still we have 2.5k clones in the queue at the moment**. It's not possible to create all clones immediately.
3. **Simply adding CPU power doesn't help**: there's a software bottleneck. When we resolve it, we will generate 2.5k clones per day even with current hardware.

What we have done so far (with yesterday release):
1. Added more power
2. Fixed issue with giving low priority to batch clones.

All in all, we work hard and do what you paid us for: scaling this thing as fast as possible.
